messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the benchmark narrative and three chart variants for next week's webinar. High-level goal: make latency vs cost feel tangible for platform and product buyers.

sam: +1. Can we pick one chart that non-technical PMs can understand in 5s?

alex: Proposal: 1) 'Cost per 1k tokens' line chart across models (clear $ axis), 2) 'Median latency vs deploy tier' scatter with size=throughput, 3) 'Tokens-per-USD by workload' stacked bar for typical app slices.

jordan: I like that. For the webinar landing page we should lead with the scatter — it tells the story of tradeoffs visually.

lee: Question: do we include Redwood Dedicated and Private as separate series or group them under "dedicated/private"?

maria: Separate series if we have reliable numbers. Otherwise group to avoid clutter. We can call out a few datapoints in the deck notes for Demos.

sam: For socials, short hook idea: "Same model. 10x different economics. See where you should run it." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex: Nice. Could simplify to: "Same models. Different cost & latency. Choose your tradeoffs." Use as h1 on a 3-card hero.

jordan: Routing: folks who click the scatter should hit a short MQL form that asks about scale and infra preference (hosted vs dedicated vs private). We can then push to sales with tiered follow-up.

lee: Ops asks: can eng provide the benchmarks export by EOD so design can mock charts? devrel-bot: export job queued — report will land in #eng-ml in ~4h.

maria: Good — timeline: export today, design mocks by tomorrow noon, rehearsal slides by Thursday. Webinar RSVP and landing by Friday.

sam: One messaging tweak: avoid heavy model names on the public chart. Call them "Model A/B/C (open)". Save specifics for the appendix.

alex: Also add a tiny caption on charts: "Measured on production-like workloads; results vary by prompt length & batching." Keeps us honest.

jordan: For the webinar, add a live demo route: show routing fallback (fastpath vs slowpath) and the cost delta — folks love concrete numbers.

lee: Design constraint: make the scatter accessible (colorblind palette + big tooltips).

maria: Action items: sam — finalize headline copy + 2 social hooks; alex — chart mock specs (axes, series, sample numbers); lee — coordinate with eng for the CSV and design; jordan — draft routing flow + MQL fields. I'll compile a one-pager with the three chart hypotheses and send to the list.

sam: Will draft copy this afternoon.

alex: Working on mocks, will ping when shapes are ready.

lee: Noted, will follow up in #eng-ml after devrel-bot posts.

maria: Thanks all. If anyone has quick examples of competitor visuals that make the tradeoff clear, drop them here — we can iterate. :sparkles:
